An '''apple empanada''' is the meal of the [[apple]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/apple_empanada.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Apple|baked apple]], sugar, estus ash and [[dough]]. Obtaining a baked apple unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating an apple empanada takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Regeneration I for 3:00.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
